name: line_chart
description: A time-series line chart that plots metric values over time. Use it to track temperatures, clock speeds, frame rates, or any value that changes over time.

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The metric whose historical values are plotted as a line over time.

config.name: history_count
config.label: History count
config.description: The number of past data points to retain and display on the chart.

config.name: label
config.label: Label
config.description: A custom label displayed on the chart. Defaults to the metric name if left empty.

config.name: font_size
config.label: Font Size
config.description: The font size in pixels used for the chart label and value text.

config.name: font_color
config.label: Font Color
config.description: The color of the chart label and value text.

config.name: font_family
config.label: Font Family
config.description: The font used for the chart label and axis text.

config.name: min
config.label: Min Value
config.description: The minimum value shown on the Y axis. Leave empty to auto-scale based on data.

config.name: max
config.label: Max Value
config.description: The maximum value shown on the Y axis. Leave empty to auto-scale based on data.

config.name: yaxis_label_font_size
config.label: Font Size
config.description: The font size in pixels used for the Y axis tick labels.

config.name: yaxis_label_space
config.label: Label Space
config.description: The horizontal space in pixels reserved for Y axis labels.

config.name: hide_yaxis
config.label: Hide
config.description: When checked, the Y axis labels and ticks are hidden.

config.name: line_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The color of the plotted line.

config.name: line_width
config.label: Width
config.description: The stroke width in pixels of the plotted line.

config.name: line_curve
config.label: Curve
config.description: The interpolation style used to draw the line between data points.
